listing.name: Breakers (Neo Geo) / Breakers-Recomp (omegakatana92)
listing.summary: Native recompilation of Breakers (Neo Geo MVS, 1996) built with NeoGeoRecomp. The 68000 code is translated to C and runs natively: real BIOS boot, 100% measured native coverage, YM2610 audio, SDL2 gamepad/keyboard input, fullscreen. Windows x64 and Steam Deck AppImage. PolyForm Noncommercial; no ROMs or BIOS included. Boot and audio fully verified.
